204	- `BuildOutputWorkbook` -- main orchestrator: reads deduplicated File A,
205	  splits by Admission Type into EM/EL, computes all stats in one pass,

390	- `BuildOutput.BuildOutputWorkbook` gained a matching `resolvedEncounters As

433	  block -> reconciliation waterfall (moved from the top; heading "Reconciliation
434	  -- for checking, not for the meeting"). Gained two `ByRef Long` out-params,

# FC Completion Report -- VBA Code Progress

This tracks what's been implemented so far vs. what's still waiting on
answers from colleagues (see `docs/FC_Completion_Report_Process_Flow_for_Review.md`
and the "Outstanding blanks" list in `CLAUDE.md`).

Module files live in the project root (`*.bas`) and are mirrored into
`FCCompletion_All_Modules.txt` (the staff-facing paste-into-VBA-editor
deliverable, regenerated by concatenating the `.bas` files with a
`MODULE: <name>.bas` separator header, in this module order: Helpers,
FilterFileA, FilterFileB, DeduplicateEncounters, BuildOutput, MainMacro,
FilePickerForm, ProgressForm).

**Compile status:** `FCCompletion_All_Modules.txt` (Helpers, FilterFileA,
FilterFileB, DeduplicateEncounters, BuildOutput, MainMacro, FilePickerForm,
ProgressForm) -- **needs user re-compile** after the 2026-07-30 duplicate-highlight
bug fix (see "2026-07-30 bug fix: duplicate-highlight visual aid never reached
the user" section below -- DeduplicateEncounters, MainMacro, and BuildOutput
all changed a shared function signature). Previously **needs user re-compile**
after the 2026-07-30 consolidated
change set (see "2026-07-30 consolidated change set" section below --
Helpers, FilterFileB, DeduplicateEncounters (doc comment only), BuildOutput,
and MainMacro all changed). Previously **needs user re-compile** after the
2026-07-29 conflict resolution (see "2026-07-29 conflict resolution" section
below -- every module except ProgressForm.bas changed). Previous modules compiled cleanly
as of 2026-06-10; not re-verified since.

---

## Done

### Helpers.bas
- `FindColByHeader`, `NormHeader` -- header-based column lookup, copied
  verbatim from the MFC macro.
- `FindEncounterCol` -- tries "Encounter Number" (File A) then "Encounter No"
  (File B), since the two eFC exports label this column differently.
- `ValidateFileHeaders` -- FilePickerForm validation for `FC_SUMMARY` (File A)
  and `INFLIGHT_MISSED` (File B).
- `IsMissedFCColumnBlank` -- detects the File B "Missed FC column entirely
  blank" workaround case from CLAUDE.md.
- `CreateConfigSheet` / `LoadStaffRoster` / `GetStaffTeam` -- builds and reads
  a "Staff Name -> Team" roster table on a `Config` sheet. Teams: ED/EDFC,
  Inflight, NCID AO, ICH PSO, Admin/Managers, Others (default for anyone not
  listed).

### ProgressForm.bas
Reused as-is from the MFC macro, caption updated to "FC Completion Report --
Generating".

### FilePickerForm.bas
2-slot dashboard (File A: FC Summary Report, File B: Inflight Missed FC
Report) -- Browse/status per slot, duplicate-file check, Missed-FC-blank
warning, Generate enabled only when both slots are valid.

**Note:** status indicators use plain ASCII ("Valid" / "Invalid" / "O" / "X
Same file") instead of the `(check)/(cross)/(circle)/(warning)` symbols used
in the MFC form. CLAUDE.md requires `FCCompletion_All_Modules.txt` to stay in
clean ASCII (the MFC project has had repeated Unicode-corruption issues
needing `fix_qmarks.ps1`-style cleanup) -- using ASCII from the start avoids
that for this project. Flag if you'd prefer the Unicode symbols anyway.

### FilterFileA.bas (Steps 1-2)
- `FilterFCMode` -- keep only "Financial Counselling - AH" /
  "Financial Counselling - Downtime".
- `DeleteCancelledAdmissions` -- drop Admission Status = "Cancelled".

### FilterFileB.bas (Steps 1-4 of the process flow doc)
- `FilterFCModeIfPresent` -- no-op if File B has no "FC Mode" column
  (CLAUDE.md blank #2).
- `KeepOnlyMissedFC` -- keep only Missed FC = "Yes".
- `DeleteCancelledOrPlanned` -- drop Admission Status = "Cancelled"/"Planned".
- `FlagEDVWDischarges` -- adds an informational "EDVW Discharge" column
  (Point Of Care = "TTSH Virtual Ward" + Accommodation Code = "EDVW"). Rows
  are NOT removed -- this is a label only, per the process flow doc's current
  proposal for Q5.

### DeduplicateEncounters.bas (Steps 3, 5-8)
- `GetFCStatusPriority` -- the 10-level priority table from the process flow
  doc (Q2).
- `AddPriorityColumn` -- writes a "PRIORITISE" column.
- `MarkDuplicateEncounters` -- highlights duplicate Encounter Numbers in red
  (visual aid).
- `ResolveDuplicateEncounters` -- automatically picks one row per Encounter
  Number (lowest priority wins, tie-break by larger FC ID), applies the
  Inflight-creator exception (Q3) via the Config roster, deletes the rest, and
  counts Voided/Deleted-only encounters (Q4) for the final report.

**Note (2026-06-18):** Q2-Q4 (and all other process flow questions) are now
confirmed -- see "Process flow confirmation" section below. The Inflight
exception is driven entirely by the `Config` roster; with an empty roster
`GetStaffTeam` returns "Others" for everyone, so the exception is inert until
real staff names are filled in.

---

## Process flow confirmation (2026-06-18)

All 8 questions from `docs/FC_Completion_Report_Process_Flow_for_Review.md`
have been confirmed by the user. The process flow doc is now the authoritative
spec -- its rules should be implemented as written.

| Q# | Decision |
|---|---|
| Q1 | EM/EL split by Admission Type only -- no Point of Care condition |
| Q2 | FC Status priority order is correct as written |
| Q3 | Inflight-created FC set aside in favour of non-Inflight (confirmed) |
| Q4 | Voided/Deleted-only encounters fully excluded from denominator |
| Q5 | EDVW discharges count as missed FC (flagged, not excluded) |
| Q6 | Team set confirmed: ED/EDFC, Inflight, NCID AO, ICH PSO, Admin/Managers, Others |
| Q7 | Fall back to FC Created By when Latest CCF Creation User is blank, but **highlight** those rows |
| Q8 | Conservative principle confirmed -- ambiguous cases default to not completed |

---

## 2026-07-29 conflict resolution

Resolved five spec conflicts between "Guide to monthly processing of report
3.docx" (the authoritative process guide) and
`docs/FC_Completion_Report_Process_Flow_for_Review.md`, which had silently
diverged from the guide by the time Q1-Q8 were confirmed 2026-06-18. Also
made File B optional and fixed a latent en-dash comparison bug. Every module
except `ProgressForm.bas` changed; the merged deliverable was regenerated
from the edited `.bas` files.

**Decision 1 -- EM/EL split now requires Point of Care (Q1 revised).**
- `Helpers.bas`: `CreateConfigSheet` adds a "NCID EL Point of Care" list
  (column D, ships empty with a header comment) alongside the staff roster.
  New `LoadNCIDPointOfCareList` returns a `vbTextCompare` Dictionary.
- `BuildOutput.bas`: `BuildOutputWorkbook` now computes a per-row `secArr()`
  section classification (SEC_EM / SEC_EL / 0) in its main pass -- an
  Elective Inpatient row only gets SEC_EL if its Point of Care matches the
  Config list. `WriteFilteredFileASheet` was changed to filter by this
  pre-computed array instead of re-deriving from Admission Type text, so the
  EL sheet actually honours the gate. If the list is empty, `elComputed =
  False`: a MsgBox warns the user, the EL sheet/summary block/methodology
  text are skipped, and EM is still produced normally. PoC-mismatched
  Elective rows are counted in a new `elPocExcluded` footnote, not silently
  dropped.

**Decision 2 -- priority 99 means Voided/Deleted only.**
- `DeduplicateEncounters.bas`: `GetFCStatusPriority` now matches "VOID" /
  "DELET" substrings (case-insensitive) for 99; everything else not in the
  six explicit statuses is 98 (was: statuses 7/8/9 for Draft variants, else
  99 for anything unrecognised). 98 stays IN the denominator; only 99 is
  excluded.
- `BuildOutput.bas`: the main stats pass collects distinct FC Status text
  landing on priority 98 into an `unrecognisedStatuses` Dictionary, printed
  as a warning block on the Summary sheet.

**Decision 3 -- five colour bands, Drafts split out.**
- `BuildOutput.bas`: `WriteSummaryBlock` rewritten with Green (1-2) / Pink
  (3) / Light Green (4-5) / Orange (6) / White-none-Draft (98) / Grey
  (missed), plus a "Not completed (total)" subtotal (Orange + Draft +
  Missed) and a visible "Total" row with a red MISMATCH flag if the bands
  don't sum to the denominator. Counter variables renamed to match the new
  bands (`pinkCt`, `ltGreenCt`, `orangeCt`, `draftCt` replace the old
  `lgCt`/`orgCt`/`redCt`).

**Decision 4 -- narrowed Inflight duplicate exception.**
- `DeduplicateEncounters.bas`: `ResolveDuplicateEncounters` now computes a
  "plain" winner (lowest priority, tie-break larger FC ID) across ALL
  candidates first. The Inflight exception only overrides it when a non-
  Inflight ED/EDFC-created candidate is present AND the winner picked from
  non-Inflight candidates has priority <= 2; otherwise the plain winner
  stands. Two new `ByRef` out-params, `inflightExceptionApplied` and
  `inflightExceptionBlocked`, are threaded through `MainMacro.bas` into the
  final MsgBox and the Methodology sheet.

**Decision 5 -- File B is now optional.**
- `FilePickerForm.bas`: File B slot is optional (label updated); Generate
  enables once File A is valid (File B, if selected, must still be header-
  valid). Added a "Missed FC count (dashboard workaround)" text box
  (default 0), validated as a non-negative integer on Generate, exposed as
  `Public MissedFCManualCount`.
- `MainMacro.bas`: rewritten to use a running `stepNum`/`totalSteps` counter
  (8 base steps + 4 more if File B present) instead of a hardcoded constant;
  File B's four cleaning steps are skipped entirely when absent; `wbB.Close`
  is guarded by `hasFileB`.
- `BuildOutput.bas`: `BuildOutputWorkbook` accepts `missedFCManualCount`
  instead of assuming `fileBws` is always present. When File B is absent,
  the manual count is attributed entirely to EM (documented in the
  Methodology sheet -- the dashboard workaround doesn't distinguish
  Elective/NCID AO cases) and the "Missed FC" sheet is skipped.

**Also fixed -- en dash bug (not a conflict, a latent crash).**
- `Helpers.bas`: new `NormalizeDashesAndSpaces` normalises `Chr(150)` /
  `ChrW(8211)` (en dash) and `ChrW(8212)` (em dash) to a plain hyphen and
  collapses whitespace, built via `ChrW()` so the source stays ASCII.
  `FilterFileA.FilterFCMode`, `FilterFileB.FilterFCModeIfPresent`, and
  `DeduplicateEncounters.GetFCStatusPriority` now run both sides of their
  FC Mode / FC Status comparisons through it -- the guide's sample data uses
  an en dash ("Financial Counselling <U+2013> AH"), which would otherwise
  make `FilterFCMode` delete every row.

Docs updated to match: `CLAUDE.md` (priority table detail, colour table
Draft/White row, outstanding blanks #6, File B optionality) and
`docs/FC_Completion_Report_Process_Flow_for_Review.md` (priority table,
Section 2 steps 6 and 9, Section 3/4 File B optionality and Config PoC list,
Section 5A five-band table, Section 7 Q1/Q3 revision notes).

---

### BuildOutput.bas (2026-06-18 -- major expansion)
- `BuildOutputWorkbook` -- main orchestrator: reads deduplicated File A,
  splits by Admission Type into EM/EL, computes all stats in one pass,
  creates output workbook with 6 sheets, saves via FileDialog.
- EM/EL split (process flow Step 9): purely by Admission Type (Q1 confirmed).
  Adds 3 extra columns: "CCF Closed By" (resolved name), "CCF Closer Team",
  "Looks Wrong" (flags EM closed by NCID AO, or EL closed by ED/EDFC/Inflight).
- `WriteSummarySheet` / `WriteSummaryBlock` -- colour-coded completion
  breakdown (Green/LightGreen/Orange/Red per process flow Section 5A),
  "Who Closed the CCF" by team (Section 5B), FC Activity Detail (Section 5C).
  All computed 3 times: EM, EL, Combined. Footnotes for voided/other.
- `WriteMethodologySheet` -- plain-language explanation of every rule with
  this month's actual numbers (process flow Section 6 item 5).
- `BuildStaffRosterCheckSheet` -- per-team roster coverage check (per
  2026-06-11 design spec). Matched / Not Matched flag against File A data.
- `HighlightCCFFallbackRows` -- highlights yellow any row where Latest CCF
  Creation User was blank and fell back to FC Created By (Q7).
- `WriteMissedFCSheet` -- copies cleaned File B data as-is.
- Output file naming: `FCReportSummary_<MonthName><Year>.xlsx` (per 2026-06-11
  addendum), suggested via SaveAs dialog.

### MainMacro.bas (2026-06-18 -- new module)
- `GenerateFCCompletionReport` -- entry point (Alt+F8). Full pipeline:
  FilePickerForm -> load roster -> clean File A (filter + dedup) ->
  clean File B (filter) -> BuildOutputWorkbook -> close inputs -> success dialog.
  12-step ProgressForm integration. Error handling with Cleanup label.

---

## 2026-07-30 consolidated change set

Validated against a real export (`FCSummaryReport_20260730084420.xlsx`, June
2026, 7,434 rows) and the team's manually produced report for the same
month. Every number below was independently re-derived from the export file
and matches the validation target exactly: rows loaded 7,434 -> after FC
Mode filter 7,432 (2 Shopper rows dropped) -> after Cancelled filter 7,432
(no Cancelled rows) -> unique encounters 6,659 -> 613 duplicate groups (773
rows removed) -> of which Voided/Deleted only 56 (8 EM, 48 EL) -> of which
unrecognised status 0 -> 1 encounter lost entirely to the FC Mode filter
(Shopper-only, blank Encounter No) -> DENOMINATOR 6,659 -> EM 6,033, EL 626
(of which NCID wards 12).

### PART 1 -- data-value fixes
- `BuildOutput.bas`: `ADM_ELECTIVE` constant changed from `"Elective
  Inpatient"` to `"Elective inpa"` (the real export truncates it) and
  matching switched from an exact-equality check to a normalised
  `"ELECTIVE INPA"` prefix match (new `IsElectiveAdmType` helper), so both
  the truncated and a hypothetical full-word value match. Applied both to
  the File A section split and the File B missed-FC Admission Type split.
- `BuildOutput.bas`: `TryParseDMYDate` renamed to `TryParseMDYDate` and
  fixed -- the real export writes dates as M/D/Y (`6/15/2026`), but the old
  function read the first part as day, so `DateSerial` silently rolled dates
  into the wrong month/year. Now parses M/D/Y and rejects out-of-range
  month/day instead of letting `DateSerial` roll over. `GetReportPeriodLabel`
  updated to call the renamed function.
- `FilterFileB.bas`: `FlagEDVWDischarges` now tries `"Accommodation Code"`
  first, then falls back to the export's `"Accomodation Code"` misspelling
  (one "m") -- confirmed present in the real File A export at column S, so
  likely present in File B's format too.
- `Helpers.bas`: `CreateConfigSheet` now prefills the "NCID EL Point of Care"
  list (column D) with the 10 confirmed ward values, still user-editable.

### PART 2 -- reversions
- **Revert A** (`BuildOutput.bas`): removed the Point of Care gate on the EL
  sheet added in the 2026-07-29 conflict resolution. Tested against the real
  export it produced EL=12 vs. a manual count of 627 -- clearly wrong. EL is
  now every Elective Inpatient encounter (Admission Type alone, the Q1
  answer as originally confirmed 2026-06-18). Removed `elComputed`,
  `elSkippedCount`, the empty-list `MsgBox`, and the "EL skipped" Summary
  branch. The EL sheet is now always produced. The Config NCID Point of Care
  list and its loader (`LoadNCIDPointOfCareList`) are kept -- reused for
  PART 3's informational NCID Ward breakdown.
- **Revert B** (`BuildOutput.bas`, `DeduplicateEncounters.bas` doc comment
  only): Voided/Deleted-only encounters (priority 99) are back IN the
  denominator and IN "not completed" -- matches the manual report (56 this
  month: 8 EM + 48 EL) but disagrees with the original Q4 answer, which
  excluded them. They get their own uncoloured "Voided/Deleted only" Summary
  row under the "Not completed (total)" subtotal. `WriteSummaryBlock` gained
  a `voidedCt` parameter; the "Not completed (total)" and "Total" bandSum
  calculations both include it now.
- Priority 98 vs. 99 split itself is unchanged (per PART 2.3 -- verified, no
  code change): 99 still matches "VOID"/"DELET" substrings, 98 is everything
  else unrecognised. Both are now in the denominator, but still separately
  counted (`voidCt` / `draftCt`) and separately reported.
- **Shopper-only encounter counter** (`Helpers.bas`, `MainMacro.bas`): new
  `CountBlankEncounterRows` helper plus the existing
  `GetDistinctEncounterSet`/`CountKeysNotIn` -- `MainMacro` snapshots
  encounter sets/blank-encounter-row counts before and after `FilterFCMode`
  runs. The real export's 2 Shopper rows both have a BLANK Encounter No (no
  Encounter Number at all for that FC Mode), so a plain distinct-encounter
  diff would report 0 lost, not 1 -- a blank encounter number can't be
  disambiguated into separate real encounters, so all rows lost to blank
  encounters count as at most one indeterminate "encounter". Reported on the
  Summary/Methodology sheets: "N encounter(s) excluded -- only form was a
  Shopper enquiry or other non-FC mode."

### PART 3 -- output additions (`BuildOutput.bas`)
- NCID Point of Care is now an informational breakdown, not a gate: a 4th
  extra column "NCID Ward" (Yes/No) on the EM/EL sheets, an "of which NCID
  wards" summary sub-block under EL (own green/pink/lt-green/orange/draft/
  voided/team counters, computed in the same main pass), and a warning block
  listing any Point of Care value containing "NCID" that isn't in the
  configured list.

# Summary Restructure + Native Charts Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** Reorder the FC Completion Report's Summary sheet so the status breakdown leads, add a headline block, and add six native Excel charts (two on Summary, four on a new Analytics sheet) driven by a hidden ChartData sheet.

**Architecture:** All chart source data is written to a new very-hidden `ChartData` sheet as contiguous blocks, copied from the same variables that already populate the visible tables (never recomputed). A single reusable `ChartHelpers.AddChartFromBlock` helper (guarded with `On Error`) builds every chart so one chart failure never aborts report generation. Band fill colours are extracted into shared `ChartHelpers` constants so a table cell and its chart segment can never disagree. A new `Analytics.bas` module owns a new "Analytics" sheet (Point-of-Care ward gap, day-of-week, EM turnaround, EL lead-time blocks) and its four charts; `BuildOutput.bas` keeps owning the Summary sheet and its two charts.

**Tech Stack:** Excel VBA (no build system, no test runner -- verification is `grep` for structural integrity plus a user compile/run pass in Excel).

## Global Constraints

- Every change goes into BOTH the relevant `*.bas` file AND `FCCompletion_All_Modules.txt` (clean ASCII, `--` for dashes, no smart quotes).
- `Option Explicit` in every module; resolve columns via `FindColByHeader`/`FindEncounterCol`, never hardcoded letters.
- VBA has no short-circuit evaluation -- never `IIf()` an array index; use explicit `If` guards.
- No 3D charts, no gradients, no shadows -- flat fills only.
- Every chart-creation path is wrapped in `On Error` so a charting failure skips that chart (with a note left on the sheet) and never aborts report generation -- the tables are the deliverable, charts are presentation.
- Band colours (used by both the Summary table fills and every band-coloured chart) live in ONE place: `ChartHelpers.bas` constants.
  - Green `RGB(146,208,80)`, Pink `RGB(255,199,206)`, Light Green `RGB(198,239,206)`, Orange `RGB(255,192,0)`, Draft only `RGB(242,242,242)`, Voided only `RGB(217,217,217)`, Missed FC `RGB(166,166,166)`.
- Chart data columns/timestamps: `1st CCF Creation Date-Time` and `Latest CCF Creation Date-Time` are resolved by header text (`FindColByHeader`), never by letter. `1st CCF ETBS` / `Latest CCF ETBS` are currency (dollar amounts) and must never be used as timestamps.

' Parses an eFC-format timestamp string "M/D/Y H:MM:SS AM/PM" into a Date
' value carrying both date and time-of-day (VBA Date is a Double: integer
' part = date, fractional part = time). Time part is optional -- if absent,
' the result carries a time of midnight. Returns False on blank/malformed
' text or an out-of-range month/day (same M/D/Y convention bug class as
' BuildOutput.TryParseMDYDate -- see that function's history comment).
Public Function TryParseMDYDateTime(dateText As String, ByRef result As Date) As Boolean
    Dim txt As String
    txt = Trim(dateText)
    If txt = "" Then
        TryParseMDYDateTime = False
        Exit Function
    End If

    Dim spacePos As Long
    spacePos = InStr(txt, " ")
    Dim datePart As String, timePart As String
    If spacePos > 0 Then
        datePart = Left(txt, spacePos - 1)
        timePart = Trim(Mid(txt, spacePos + 1))
    Else
        datePart = txt
        timePart = ""
    End If

    Dim dparts() As String
    dparts = Split(datePart, "/")
    If UBound(dparts) <> 2 Then
        TryParseMDYDateTime = False
        Exit Function
    End If
    If Not IsNumeric(dparts(0)) Or Not IsNumeric(dparts(1)) Or Not IsNumeric(dparts(2)) Then
        TryParseMDYDateTime = False
        Exit Function
    End If

    Dim m As Long, dd As Long, y As Long
    m = CLng(dparts(0)): dd = CLng(dparts(1)): y = CLng(dparts(2))
    If y < 100 Then y = y + 2000
    If m < 1 Or m > 12 Or dd < 1 Or dd > 31 Then
        TryParseMDYDateTime = False
        Exit Function
    End If

    Dim baseDate As Date
    On Error GoTo Fail
    baseDate = DateSerial(y, m, dd)

    Dim timeFraction As Double
    timeFraction = 0
    If timePart <> "" Then
        Dim ampm As String
        Dim tparts() As String
        Dim hh As Long, mi As Long, ss As Long
        Dim ampmPos As Long
        Dim workingTime As String
        workingTime = timePart

        ampmPos = InStr(1, workingTime, "AM", vbTextCompare)
        If ampmPos = 0 Then ampmPos = InStr(1, workingTime, "PM", vbTextCompare)
        If ampmPos > 0 Then
            ampm = UCase(Mid(workingTime, ampmPos, 2))
            workingTime = Trim(Left(workingTime, ampmPos - 1))
        Else
            ampm = ""
        End If

        tparts = Split(workingTime, ":")
        If UBound(tparts) >= 1 Then
            If IsNumeric(tparts(0)) Then hh = CLng(tparts(0)) Else hh = 0
            If IsNumeric(tparts(1)) Then mi = CLng(tparts(1)) Else mi = 0
            If UBound(tparts) >= 2 Then
                If IsNumeric(tparts(2)) Then ss = CLng(tparts(2)) Else ss = 0
            Else
                ss = 0
            End If

            If ampm = "PM" And hh < 12 Then hh = hh + 12
            If ampm = "AM" And hh = 12 Then hh = 0

            timeFraction = (hh * 3600 + mi * 60 + ss) / 86400
        End If
    End If

    result = CDate(CDbl(baseDate) + timeFraction)
    TryParseMDYDateTime = True
    Exit Function
Fail:
    TryParseMDYDateTime = False
End Function

Attribute VB_Name = "ChartHelpers"
Option Explicit

' ============================================================
' ChartHelpers.bas
'
' Shared native-chart infrastructure for the FC Completion Report:
'   - Band colour constants (used by BOTH the Summary table fills and every
'     band-coloured chart, so a table cell and its chart segment can never
'     disagree)
'   - EnsureChartDataSheet -- the single very-hidden sheet every chart's
'     source range lives on (contiguous blocks only -- non-contiguous
'     SetSourceData ranges are the main source of VBA charting failures)
'   - AddChartFromBlock -- one reusable chart-creation helper, guarded with
'     On Error so a charting failure skips that chart (never aborts report
'     generation -- the tables are the deliverable, charts are presentation)
' ============================================================

Public Const SHEET_CHARTDATA As String = "ChartData"

' Seven completion-status band colours -- must match WriteSummaryBlock's
' table fills exactly (BuildOutput.bas) so a coloured table cell and its
' chart segment never disagree.
Public Const BAND_COLOR_GREEN As Long = 5287310      ' RGB(146,208,80)
Public Const BAND_COLOR_PINK As Long = 13556223       ' RGB(255,199,206)
Public Const BAND_COLOR_LTGREEN As Long = 13561542    ' RGB(198,239,206)
Public Const BAND_COLOR_ORANGE As Long = 49152        ' RGB(255,192,0)
Public Const BAND_COLOR_DRAFT As Long = 15921906      ' RGB(242,242,242)
Public Const BAND_COLOR_VOIDED As Long = 14277081     ' RGB(217,217,217)
Public Const BAND_COLOR_MISSED As Long = 10921638     ' RGB(166,166,166)

' Finds the very-hidden ChartData sheet, creating it (as the last sheet in
' the workbook) if it does not yet exist. Safe to call multiple times per
' report run -- every chart-writing routine calls this before writing its
' block.
Public Function EnsureChartDataSheet(wb As Workbook) As Worksheet
    Dim ws As Worksheet
    On Error Resume Next
    Set ws = wb.Sheets(SHEET_CHARTDATA)
    On Error GoTo 0

    If ws Is Nothing Then
        Set ws = wb.Sheets.Add(After:=wb.Sheets(wb.Sheets.Count))
        ws.Name = SHEET_CHARTDATA
    End If

    ws.Visible = xlSheetVeryHidden
    Set EnsureChartDataSheet = ws
End Function

' Creates one chart anchored at anchorCell's top-left corner, sized
' widthPts x heightPts, sourced from srcRange (expected to be a contiguous
' block on the ChartData sheet). seriesColours is a 0-based Variant array of
' RGB Longs (one per series, in SeriesCollection order); pass Empty entries
' to skip colouring a given series (e.g. when a chart type applies its own
' per-point colouring instead). Returns Nothing if anything fails -- callers
' MUST check for Nothing and skip gracefully; a charting failure must never
' abort report generation.
Public Function AddChartFromBlock(targetWs As Worksheet, anchorCell As Range, srcRange As Range, _
        chartType As XlChartType, titleText As String, _
        widthPts As Single, heightPts As Single, _
        seriesColours As Variant, chartName As String) As ChartObject

    On Error GoTo Fail

    Dim co As ChartObject
    Set co = targetWs.ChartObjects.Add(anchorCell.Left, anchorCell.Top, widthPts, heightPts)
    co.Name = chartName

    With co.Chart
        .SetSourceData Source:=srcRange, PlotBy:=xlColumns
        .ChartType = chartType
        .HasTitle = True
        .ChartTitle.Text = titleText

        If Not IsEmpty(seriesColours) Then
            Dim k As Long
            For k = LBound(seriesColours) To UBound(seriesColours)
                If Not IsEmpty(seriesColours(k)) Then
                    On Error Resume Next
                    .SeriesCollection(k - LBound(seriesColours) + 1).Format.Fill.ForeColor.RGB = CLng(seriesColours(k))
                    On Error GoTo Fail
                End If
            Next k
        End If

        If .SeriesCollection.Count > 1 Then
            .HasLegend = True
            .Legend.Position = xlLegendPositionBottom
        Else
            .HasLegend = False
        End If

        .ChartArea.Format.Line.Visible = msoFalse
    End With

    Set AddChartFromBlock = co
    Exit Function

Fail:
    Set AddChartFromBlock = Nothing
End Function

        elEnc As Long, missedEL As Long, elGreen As Long, elPink As Long, elLtGreen As Long)

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Bold = True
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Size = 12

    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = "Denominator"
    ws.Cells(r, 3).Value = "Completed"
    ws.Cells(r, 4).Value = "Completed %"

    r = r + 1

    Dim emCompleted As Long, elCompleted As Long, combCompleted As Long

    combDenom = emDenom + elDenom
    emCompleted = emGreen + emPink + emLtGreen

    combCompleted = emCompleted + elCompleted

    WriteHeadlineRow ws, r, "Combined (EM + EL)", combDenom, combCompleted

Attribute VB_Name = "Analytics"

' ============================================================
' Analytics.bas
'
' Builds the FC Completion Report's "Analytics" sheet: four blocks, each
' with a native chart, each sourced from a contiguous block on the shared
' ChartData sheet (see ChartHelpers.bas) copied from the SAME variables
' used to write the visible table -- never recomputed, so a chart and its

'   4. EL lead time -- Admission Date minus 1st CCF Creation Date-Time in

'      vs. completion rate (Chart 6)
'
' All four charts are guarded with On Error inside
' ChartHelpers.AddChartFromBlock -- a charting failure skips that chart and
' leaves a note on the sheet; it never aborts report generation.
' ============================================================

Public Const SHEET_ANALYTICS As String = "Analytics"

' make up "Not completed (total)" on the Summary sheet, minus Missed FC
' (which has no Point of Care value to attribute to a ward).
Private Function IsNotDonePriority(pri As Long) As Boolean
    IsNotDonePriority = (pri = 6 Or pri = 98 Or pri = 99)
End Function
